title: Outcome report
description: For one month, from the library's records and the outbox's events: the loans opened per tool in the catalog (TL-BO01), the share of loans due that month returned late or still out and overdue (TL-BO02), the loans opened on a tool that needed repair (TL-BO03), and the members who opened a loan in the 90 days to the month's end (TL-BO04).
